summary.text: Ty Moore is a Republican state representative from Ohio who was appointed to District 95 in June 2025 and is seeking election to a full term on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists him as a business owner and vice president.

paragraphs.text: Ty Moore was born in Caldwell, Ohio, and earned a bachelor's degree from Bucknell University.
His career experience includes working as a business owner and vice president, according to Ballotpedia.
The Ohio House of Representatives appointed Moore to the District 95 seat on June 18, 2025, to replace Don Jones.
He advanced unopposed from the May 5, 2026 Republican primary and faces Democrat Paul Cameron in the general election.
